name: Phthalates
aliases: phthalates, DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIDP, phthalic acid esters, ftalatos
what_is: A group of synthetic chemical plasticizers used to make food-contact plastics flexible.
why_botia: EFSA's 2019 review covered five phthalates: DBP, BBP, DEHP, DINP and DIDP. The first four share a temporary intake limit; DIDP has its own. The review did not show that phthalates as a class cause endometriosis or PCOS.
can_1: Detect warning indicators or material types that may release phthalates when heated.
can_2: Explain what EFSA found for DBP, BBP, DEHP, DINP and DIDP, including DIDP's separate limit. A food label alone cannot show whether a phthalate migrated into the food, or how much.
cannot_1: Directly detect phthalate concentrations in food via visual OCR of the packaging.
cannot_2: Verify if migration levels from plastic gaskets or wraps exceed the European specific migration limits (SML).

sources.label: EFSA Scientific Opinion on Phthalates in Food Contact Materials (2019)
WHO State of the Science of Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals (2012)
